svg.title: PangoLock: zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS
svg.desc: PangoLock, a zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS. Key flow: password plus salt, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 x210,000, master key with a zero-knowledge verifier, HKDF-SHA256 per-item key, AES-256-GCM, atomic write of uuid.plock, decrypt and compare, original removed, vault locked. 87 XCTest tests, CI on macOS. MIT, v0.2.1, pre-1.0.
svg.text: 87 XCTEST TESTS · CI BUILDS + TESTS ON macOS
THREAT MODEL · CRASH-WINDOW TESTS · RECOVERY KEY
